topology: 1 node x4 H100, NVSHMEM put-ring, BOTH providers in one process
why: regression test for provider coexistence (7a5b55a): ib + gpumem loaded into ONE process, both writing into ONE capture. Same workload/topology as 04, the only variable is the second provider — so a coexistence regression shows up here and nowhere else.
scope_note: single-node, so NVSHMEM never posts an IB send (every peer is NVLink-reachable): the ib side contributes entities (MR/QP/modify_qp), not traffic. Cross-transport TRAFFIC correlation needs 2 nodes — see 07_nvshmem_multinode.
workload_note: identical to case 04 by construction — `putget 65536 3` on 4 PEs — because the only variable this case changes is the second provider. Both cases assert the same derivation against the same oracle, which is what makes the comparison between them evidence rather than coincidence.

expect_fail_asserts.entity_close_accounted: LIVE GAP, narrowed twice. Found by this assertion on its first run (job 44358674): closes naming entities nothing created, ~47 of 290 per rank on case 02. ROUND 1 — ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr was hooked (job 44363138). It was a real missing door and it closed NVSHMEM's half: case 07's symmetric heap went from absent to 512MB+1GB regions with per-rank device attribution, which also falsified that case's gpudirect=0. It did NOT close NCCL's: ~42 unmatched per rank, against only 40 dmabuf regions across all 8 ranks. ROUND 2 — EntityClose gained `opener`, the type_id of the record that should have created the subject. Job 44363299 says all 33 remaining unmatched closes are opener=100, ib_mem_region. So the residue is a REGISTRATION path, not queue-pair creation — ib_queue_pair is fully accounted for. NOT mlx5dv_reg_dmabuf_mr, at least not here: this case runs providers=['ib'], so that interposer is not even loaded and hooking it cannot change this board. Next instrument, and do not skip to a hook: our dlsym interposer sees every dlsym, and NCCL resolves its ibv_* entry points that way (nccl src/misc/ibvsymbols.cc). Logging which registration symbols are RESOLVED gives the candidate set definitively. Resolution is not invocation — that is the case 08 lesson — so it narrows rather than concludes. Do not weaken this assertion: it has now found one real door and precisely characterised a second.
